name: haskell-validation-diagnostics
command: import subprocess,json; commands=[["kore-exec","/workspace/out/kompiled/definition.kore","--module","KONTROL-MAIN","--output","/workspace/out/kompiled/haskellDefinition.bin","--serialize","--log-level","debug"],["kore-parser","--no-print-definition","/workspace/out/kompiled/definition.kore"],["kore-exec","/missing-exp02-definition.kore","--module","KONTROL-MAIN","--serialize","--log-level","debug"]]; observations=[]; [(observations.append({"command":command,"exit_code":run.returncode,"stdout":run.stdout,"stderr":run.stderr})) for command in commands for run in [subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35)]]; print(json.dumps(observations,indent=2))
